svg.title: One web across the centuries
svg.desc: Two arc diagrams of the 72,094 cross-references that ten or more readers endorse, each book placed on a line of time at the middle of its date range. On traditional dates 35% of the links reach back more than 500 years and 8% more than 1,000. On the latest dates critical scholarship gives, 31% still reach back more than 500 years. On both, every one of the 44 writers the critical view counts is within 2 steps of every other. Red arcs span 1,000 years or more, blue 500 to 1,000, grey under 500. A book the critical view gives no date of its own, such as Psalms, keeps its traditional date.
svg.text: Cross-references placed by when each book was written, not by canon order
72,094 links endorsed by ten or more readers (OpenBible.info). Each end sits at the middle of its
book's date range; Psalms spans Moses to the exile, so its links meet at one point. A book the
critical view gives no date of its own keeps its traditional date (ESV Study Bible introductions).
After the manner of Clarence Larkin · the-way.lewy.au
